registrationScope: Internal pre-observation technical execution specification; not a registered human study or population benchmark
selectionRule: Previously illustrated PD pathway with smallest original fgsea adjusted p-value, fixed before this task comparison
nativeInputPolicy: Use the same frozen primary differential-expression and fgsea arrays, identifiers, NA patterns, contrast direction and testing families for all tools.
If a DESeqDataSet must be reconstructed, use the captured counts and already transformed metadata; prove same-environment 1e-8 parity before supplying the original arrays.

Supply additional common fields through documented native annotation/contrast inputs where supported and record exact mapping/preprocessing. Do not patch a competitor renderer or invent a custom template.
Give every tool identical case-specific companion evidence bytes and a manifest. A missing native affordance describes the prepared report configuration, not whole-tool incapability.
Native HTML and unique companion byte sizes are descriptive; human effort, speed and interpretation accuracy are unmeasured.

observations.unit: Tool by task component by delivery
rules: Keep access route separate from semantic judgment; biological truth not established can be the correct answer.
Record multipart tasks per component, with actual values, source row/key, access route, screenshot/selector or export receipt and limits.
Hidden JSON extraction is an embedded machine record, not a visible report control.

Expected numerical values derive from frozen source arrays previously validated by independent package calls; delivery truth derives independently from the declared transformations, not the PNV checker prediction.
Do not provide an answer-key summary as the companion. Supply underlying original evidence.
No weighted feature total, overall winner, task-time comparison, diagnostic accuracy estimate or participant-effect estimate.

deliveries.base: Original matched PD statistical results, captured design and complete shared evidence.
deliveries.consistent: Original supplied files and requested contrast agree with captured execution records.
deliveries.contrast_conflict: Retain original arrays and actual execution records; reverse only requested handoff contrast, identically for every tool.
deliveries.missing_required_file: Retain original arrays; omit the same declared required input artifact from each delivered file set and disk. Do not silently recover it from the development workspace.
deliveries.coherent_record_only: Separate internally consistent supplied symbolic-label records with no independent specimen-label evidence. Record-only inspection for ALL tools; do not reuse an original-label document as hidden truth. Internal consistency and biological truth remain distinct.

tasks.question: Identify fitted design and positive comparison direction
Trace original tested membership and ES agreement
Locate the same-pathway group-only result and its model
Locate separate CAMERA results and test identity
Read resampling summaries and actual denominators
Identify conflicting requested contrast without changing inference
Distinguish unavailable input verification from statistical non-significance
Determine whether consistent records authenticate biological labels

limitations: Developer-defined audit tasks intentionally cover PNV's intended use; they are not representative of all pathway exploration or users.
Freezing before probes prevents post-probe task edits, not task-selection bias.
Versions, supported input mapping and report configuration bound the findings; custom templates and untested functions may expose additional capabilities.
Equal companion access preserves information; an access-route difference is not an observed time saving or interpretation-error reduction.
Constructed deliveries and record-only controls do not estimate diagnostic sensitivity or specificity.
